## Contribution checks

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ZeroHostCMS/zhst-community-plugins/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and targeted this repository's `main` branch.
- [ ] The feature is implemented and testable independently; it is not an untouched scaffold or dependent on private workspace packages.
- [ ] Source, tests, manifests, lockfile and operator instructions are included; generated builds, dependencies and local state are excluded.
- [ ] I can distribute the contribution under the repository license and have retained required third-party notices.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, private platform code, account/resource IDs or sensitive evidence are included.
- [ ] Fetching or merging this source does not install, execute, activate, deploy or register it in a gallery.
- [ ] I understand that a maintainer must select an exact SHA, manually review and evaluate/deploy it in ZeroHostCMS, then open a separate private hosting-platform promotion PR before hosting-platform publication. This community PR is not deployment approval.
